content:
incident-bot: [ALERT] GPU pool 'prefill-prod' reported sustained saturation. util=98%, queue=1,200, throttle=active. potential service impact on text-generation endpoints.
incident-bot: Severity: P1 — paging oncall: @oncall-jen, notify eng-runtime and platform.
oncall-jen: ack — joining bridge. what services are impacted?
alex-eng-runtime: seeing a sudden jump correlated with rollout vXR-12 at ~14:02 UTC. kv-cache miss rate up ~14x, avg seq len +30%.
maria-sre: autoscaler tried 3 scale-ups in the last 5m but kept hitting pool max/quota. scale attempts show "quota_limit" failures.
sam-platform: opening ticket with cloud vendor for emergency quota increase now. tagging @ops-bot.
ops-bot: Vendor ticket created REQ-9981, assigned to cloud oncall. vendor ETA ~20m.
lee-support: multiple customers reporting 503s; top affected customer acme-inc, ~54 errors/min. Support queue spiking.
csm-oliver: pinging Acme; drafting interim status.
alex-eng-runtime: quick snapshot from metrics:

```
-- 14:01:50 rollout vXR-12 -> 40% traffic
-- 14:04:10 prefill queue growth starts
-- 14:05:32 kv_cache.miss_rate: baseline 0.8 -> 11.6
-- 14:06:07 autoscaler.scale_attempts=3
```
alex-eng-runtime: hypothesis: model change in vXR-12 widened context fanout / increased KV warmup churn causing prefill amplification.
oncall-jen: mitigation plan, short list: 1) reduce vXR-12 traffic to 0% (emergency rollback), 2) route new prefill-heavy requests to dedicated burst pool, 3) temporarily tighten prefill concurrency and increase kv-cache TTL to reduce regen. anyone object?
sam-platform: no objections. starting routing change to 'burst-2' dedicated pool for bursty prefill flows.
deploy-bot: rollout vXR-12 traffic control: executing command.
alex-eng-runtime: running rollback command now:
```
redwoodctl rollout set vXR-12 --traffic 0 --reason "emergency kv-amplification"
```
maria-sre: observed autoscaler logs:
```
[14:05:10] scale_attempt desired=60 current=48 reason="queue_growth"
[14:05:42] scale_fail reason="quota_limit: max_pool_size=48"
[14:06:15] scale_attempt desired=60 current=48 reason="queue_growth"
[14:06:47] scale_fail reason="quota_limit"
```
maria-sre: we've hit configured account max — cloud quota is the blocker.
ops-bot: vendor acknowledged but cannot raise capacity immediately; ETA 20m.
sam-platform: in parallel, enabling emergency route to 'burst-2' for prefill endpoint. applying routing rule: `route.prefill -> burst-2`
alex-eng-runtime: also flipping kv-cache warmup ttl: reducing per-shard warmup to slow regen. command:
```
redwoodctl config set kv.warmup.rate=0.4
```
lee-support: after initial changes, acme errors down to ~12/min but still elevated. customers asking for credit.
csm-oliver: offering courtesy credit for affected window; notifying account team.
oncall-jen: queue length trending down: 1200 -> 430 after routing + rollback. still watching.
deploy-bot: rollout vXR-12 traffic now 0% confirmed at 14:09:21 UTC.
alex-eng-runtime: kv miss rate now 4.3x baseline — trending toward normal. CPU/GPU utilization for prefill-prod down to 86% -> 68%.
maria-sre: autoscaler snapshot after routing:
```
[14:10:02] current_pool=48 desired=50 reason="stabilizing"
[14:11:30] queue=212
```
maria-sre: marking incident as mitigated; vendor quota still pending. recommend keeping routing rule for 30m and monitoring.
lee-support: Acme confirms 503s dropped to near zero; reporting satisfied for now.
oncall-jen: handing incident over to maria-sre for remediation, postmortem and customer RCA. i'll stay available for 30m.
maria-sre: ack. immediate action items:
- capture rollout diff between vXR-10 and vXR-12 (model config + tokenizer change)
- investigate why kv-cache warmup amplified with this model (trace IDs to follow)
- add alert: kv-cache.miss_rate > 5x baseline -> high priority
- add autoscaler fallback path: when quota_limit encountered, auto-enable routing to dedicated overflow pools
csm-oliver: collecting timeline and customer messages; will draft external communication.
lee-support: sending follow-up to affected customers and logging credits.
oncall-jen: incident severity downgraded to P2. will mark bridge for close in 30m barring regressions.
incident-bot: Incident update: mitigated -> actions assigned, postmortem required.
maria-sre: starting postmortem thread and will attach logs/summaries and the rollout patch. expected draft in 24h.
alex-eng-runtime: quick note — model team: avoid increasing context fanout without performance verification in canary. add a pre-deploy load-test for kv warmup.
oncall-jen: thanks all — nice cross-team work. :thumbsup:
